items.description: Disposal of storm debris from shed and felled tree (roof timber, glass, green waste, root ball <1 m³)
items.rationale: Every element is material arising under 5.2.1(a)/(b): remains of the insured shed, tree green waste, and a single root mass under 1 m³. The combined position is therefore fully indemnifiable under 7.1.10. Priced from Case 8 levels (roof timber ~50, glass ~32, green waste ~55, root ball ~30).

items.description: Disposal of ground material from churned-up area (soil, topsoil, paving grit)
items.rationale: Ground material is excluded as material arising under 5.2.1(d) and 4.3(d). This is standalone clearance with no reinstatement or making good of the ground, so 5.2.2 is not met; Case 8 gave t = 0 for the same items.
